target.description: Independent pre-proposal architecture review of ADS governed-document metadata, provenance, reference integrity, live-state synchronization, legacy migration, and mechanical validation before any repository-wide metadata-integrity implementation is frozen.

known_exposures: Foundation 014 already records lightweight document metadata and explicitly defers stronger machine-readable metadata, staleness detection, dependency modeling and authority/supersession checks until observed maintenance pressure justifies them.

Research 103 and Research 104 already define the accepted repository information architecture, exhaustive Knowledge Map coverage for primary numbered knowledge families, and narrow current-routing validation.

Checkpoint 269 records recent continuity defects including stale current state, a duplicate Research identity, missing Knowledge Map routing and incomplete checkpoint metadata, all repaired as continuity/metadata defects.

The project owner has now asked for a repository-wide reflection on metadata and provenance across artifact families and wants the architecture improved systematically rather than through another isolated repair.
No ChatGPT implementation contract or candidate metadata schema has been frozen for MC-0008 before Claude's independent pass.
independence.notes: Claude's first pass is intended to be genuinely pre-proposal. Read the neutral MC-0008 brief and the exact frozen target only for substantive repository evidence. Do not inspect later candidate implementation/design artifacts before freezing the independent position.

last_transition.reason: The project owner requested a systematic repository metadata/provenance improvement and explicitly asked for Claude's ideas before implementation. MC-0008 therefore opens an independent pre-proposal architecture pass before ChatGPT freezes or implements a candidate design.
